prompt: A group chat argument between two friends is escalating late at night and others are taking sides in the thread. What response is most likely to help rather than fuel it?

options.text: Suggest pausing until morning when everyone is calmer, make clear you care about both friends, and avoid taking a side in the public thread
Drop in a witty comment about the argument to lighten the mood
Publicly take the side of the friend you are closer to, so they feel supported
Leave the group dramatically without a word, so everyone notices your disapproval

explanation: Tired, public arguments reward quick reactions over understanding. A pause protects both friendships and lets the two people involved sort it out properly, while side-taking and dramatic exits raise the stakes.
